desc: Trijicon's Bolt Action Mount w/ Trijicon Q-LOC Technology is designed to keep the optic as low as possible for hunting and long range precision rifle applications. Featuring a Mil-Spec drop test rated 6061-T6 aluminum design and an easy to use one handed toolless mounting system. The spring-loaded design allows for constant retention and maintaining of zero even if the knobs are not tightened.
